name: @meterian/mcp

tools.name: advisories_get
tools.description: Returns all the security advisories and license issues for a specific library, identified by its language, name, and version. This is useful to assess the security risk of a dependency. Each advisory is compact: id, description (the first sentence, at most 180 characters), severity, cvss, cwe, cve, identifiers, versionRange and one link. Set full to true only when you need the raw advisory: the complete description, all the links, the CVSS vectors and the EPSS score. The raw output can be very large.

name.description: The name of the package as it is published in its repository (e.g., 'axios' for npm, 'org.springframework:spring-web' for Maven).

full.description: When true, returns the raw advisories instead of the compact format. Default: false.

tools.name: advisories_getnextsafe
tools.description: Returns a list of safe versions for a specific library that is affected by vulnerabilities, identified by its language, name, and version. This is useful to find a version to upgrade to that is not affected by the same issues.

name.description: The name of the package as it is published in its repository (e.g., 'axios' for npm, 'org.springframework:spring-web' for Maven).
